cap_TbBoard.text:
Capabilities: status-columns, work-in-progress-limit, card-from-mail, move-card-to-change-status, group-by, team-filter.
What you see: The Northwind rollout Lyon board in five status columns. TASK #58440 is lifted between new and in development, and a dashed drop zone says the drop sets the status in OpenProject.

cap_TbCard.text:
Capabilities: work-package-panel, status-change-in-place, mails-tab, meetings-tab, activity-tab, link-a-mail, open-in-openproject.
What you see: The board behind a 480 px panel for FEATURE #58412. The tabs Mails, Meetings and Activity sit under its fields, and the Lyon conversation is summarised with Reply and Open conversation.

cap_TbMyDay.text:
Capabilities: my-day-list, reply-from-work-package, join-meeting, set-status, work-package-from-mail, week-summary.
What you see: Monday 12 October in three groups: waiting for your reply, today and due this week. Every row has one action and its work package chip. A summary on the right gives this week in plain figures.

cap_TbList.text:
Capabilities: cards-add-paste, cards-add-inherit, cards-drag-collection, dates-week-drag, cards-completed-lazy, cards-delete-completed, cards-sort-reverse, a11y-direction.
What you see: The project list of the filter Due this week, grouped by day, under the project header with the view switch on List. Three pasted lines wait in quick add, TASK #58440 is dragged towards Thursday with the collection drop targets lit, the pin tooltip says starring and pinning stay in Nextcloud, and the Closed group shows 2 of 4 with Show 2 more and Delete all closed. Frame b: the list toolbar with the sort menu open.

cap_TbSubtasks.text:
Capabilities: sub-add, sub-drag, sub-paste, sub-collapse, sub-hide-closed, sub-complete-all, sub-reopen-parent, sub-follow-list.
What you see: The Lyon project as a tree three levels deep under the List view: the questions the app asks before it touches child work packages (close, cancel or move them too, reopen the parent) drawn as frames b to e, FEATURE #58412 open with an add child field, EPIC #57990 folded with a count, closed children shown by the one switch Show closed children, and TASK #58441 dragged onto an insertion line under TASK #58460.

cap_TbFilters.text:
Capabilities: labels-filter-tags, labels-click-filter, labels-filter-user, labels-filter-unassigned, labels-filter-state, labels-filter-due, labels-mine, labels-create.
What you see: Frame a: the board filtered on tag Lyon and Open, the chips with Clear all filters, and the filter panel under the Filter button with tags to tick, Manage tags, assignee, Open or closed and the due date range. Frame b: the Tags tab of the project details where tags are renamed, recoloured, deleted, added and the six defaults restored.

cap_TbSearch.text:
Capabilities: search-fields, search-number, search-shortcut, search-prefixes, search-due-words, search-keep-parent, search-other-boards, search-global-comments.
What you see: Frame a: the header search with lyon typed and the results open: a one-line hint with Search tips, four matches in this project with a parent kept above its child, then projects, work packages and comments in other apps and projects. Frame b: the search tips with the field prefixes, the due words, the number jump and the keys.

cap_TbCardPlanning.text:
Capabilities: dates-start-set, dates-due-set, dates-shortcuts, dates-all-day, repeat-basic, repeat-sentence, remind-relative, remind-keep-discard.
What you see: The dialog opened from the due date of FEATURE #58412 over the dimmed board: a mini month with the run 5 to 30 October, start and due with a time, shortcuts, a link to the calendar day, a repetition every 2 weeks on Monday read back as a sentence, and three reminders. Frames b and c show the monthly and yearly rules, frame d the question whether a reminder stays when its date goes.

cap_TbCardDetails.text:
Capabilities: cards-open-modal, cards-open-link, cards-rename, cards-description-write, cards-description-conflict, sub-checklist-tick, attach-drop, attach-remove.
What you see: FEATURE #58412 in full width with the navigation folded: the title being renamed in place, a copy link button, the Markdown editor with its save state and a banner that Tom changed the text meanwhile, a checklist with two of four ticked, and the attachments with upload, Files, a drop zone, an overwrite question, a file over the size limit, and a removed file with Undo.

cap_TbCardFields.text:
Capabilities: cards-move-details, cards-priority, cards-percent, people-assign-groups, people-assign-remote, labels-create-inline, share-busy-only, cards-dependency-add.
What you see: The 480 px panel of FEATURE #58412 with every field in edit state: assignees as removable tokens for a person, a group and someone on another server, tags, priority as Low, Normal, High or Immediate, % complete, completion date, location, web address, what shared people see with a restricted lock, and the two work packages it depends on with Mark closed and remove. Frames b, c and d open the status menu, the assignee picker and the tag picker.

cap_TbProjects.text:
Capabilities: boards-table, boards-table-filter, boards-browse-shared, boards-browse-archived, boards-create, boards-clone-options, export-json, import-json.
What you see: Frame a: every project in one table, grouped into yours, shared with you, archived and deleted items, a new project being named with Create project, and the row menu of OpenProject core open with the delete rule in full. Frame b: the Copy project dialog. Frame c: the Export or subscribe list with plain names.

cap_TbProjectSharing.text:
Capabilities: boards-details, share-users, share-groups, share-teams, share-remote, share-rights, share-transfer, share-project.
What you see: Frame a: the project details on Members: a field that finds people, groups, teams, an e-mail address or a person on another server, the rights explained above the table, a row per member with Edit, Share and Manage switches, a group from OpenProject, a team from Nextcloud, a read-only member and one on another server. Frame b: the Files and chats tab with the linked folders and chats.

cap_TbProjectTrash.text:
Capabilities: boards-restore-lists, boards-trash-restore, boards-trash-purge-one, boards-trash-empty, boards-trash-days, cards-restore, sub-restore.
What you see: The project details on Deleted items: the one rule for deleting, restoring and deleting for good at the top, a column removed from this board with the work package it held, a deleted work package with its child work package, Restore and Delete for good per row and Delete all for good at the top.

cap_TbAdmin.text:
Capabilities: admin-limit-creation, admin-federation, admin-retention.
What you see: The Tasks page of the administration, signed in as Ines Okafor: which groups may create projects, sharing with other servers on or off, how many days deleted items are kept with the same rule as the Deleted items tab, and one save row at the bottom.

cap_TbSettings.text:
Capabilities: boards-default-list, boards-reopen-last, cards-number-badge, boards-collection-visibility, activity-subscribe, notify-due-scope, a11y-shortcut-list, a11y-shortcuts-off.
What you see: Four frames of the settings dialog over the dimmed board: General, Notifications with the due reminder mail switch, OpenProject with the signed-in account and its switches, and Keyboard shortcuts with every key and the notice that shortcuts are switched off for the account.

cap_TbBoardColumns.text:
Capabilities: boards-list-add, boards-list-rename, boards-list-delete, boards-list-reorder, boards-list-done-column, boards-list-archive-all, people-presence, mobile-drag-lists.
What you see: The Lyon board at tablet width with 44 px targets and compact cards. The menu of the column new is open with rename, make this the closed column, archive and unarchive all, and remove column from this board, each with its reach in OpenProject; a second frame shows the View menu with compact cards and archived cards only; on hold is lifted by a long press, a live notice shows a move by Tom, and the avatars say who has the board open.

cap_TbBoardCardMenu.text:
Capabilities: people-assign-self, cards-copy, cards-duplicate, cards-colour, cards-delete, export-ics-task, cards-cover, cards-link-preview.
What you see: Cards with a cover image, a sand background, a description mark, a comment count with an unread dot and checklist progress; one card whose title is a link shows as a preview. The menu of TASK #58455 offers unassign me, copy, duplicate with children, colour, download as iCalendar, archive and delete, and a toast offers undo for a deleted card.

cap_TbActivity.text:
Capabilities: activity-comment, activity-mention, activity-reply, activity-markdown, activity-board, activity-description-diff, activity-filter, activity-older.
What you see: The Activity tab of FEATURE #58412, with one Show menu and a link to the project activity. A comment field with Markdown and a mention picker open sits on top; below it Tom's comment with Olivia's reply nested under it, status and description changes with before and after, project entries, and a line that loads older comments while scrolling.

cap_TbGantt.text:
Capabilities: boards-kanban-gantt, gantt-view, gantt-scale, gantt-drag, gantt-undated, gantt-today, gantt-colours.
What you see: The Lyon project with the view switch on Gantt, the Scale menu on days and a Today button after the spacer. Bars run from start to due date in their status colour with a legend; FEATURE #58412 is being dragged two days to the right, and two work packages without dates are listed under the chart.

cap_TbShell.text:
Capabilities: integ-widget-create, integ-widget-upcoming, integ-widget-done, notify-shared, notify-shared-remote, notify-assigned, notify-mention, notify-overdue.
What you see: The dashboard with the Tasks widget: a field to add a work package and upcoming work packages with a checkbox each, one just closed. A second frame shows the notification panel under the pressed bell with a project shared with you, one from another server, an assignment, a mention, an overdue work package and a reminder you set.

cap_TbNewDialog.text:
Capabilities: cards-add-dialog, integ-chat-create, integ-picker-create, integ-picker-find, integ-link-preview.
What you see: Two frames. From a chat message the dialog opens on New work package with title, project, status column and description prefilled from Marc's message. From the smart picker in Text it opens on Find a work package with scope chips, results and a New work package action; above it the document shows previews of a pasted work package, project and comment.
